performance.verdict: Meta driving all 134 leads; Google spending $532 with zero tracked conversions.

findings.text: Google Ads spent $532.43 over 28 days with 0 tracked conversions — $0 return on every dollar; confirmed pixel/tracking failure, not a bidding problem.
5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL Build, End-to-End Stack Re-Test ⛔, Paid Landing Pages, and UGC Batch — all unconfirmed complete as of today.
3-day lead signal (Sep 6–8): 0+6+10=16 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5): 7+5+0=12 leads — mild improvement, but Sep 7–8 driven by a $174 spike vs normal ~$95/day.
GHL shows 134 leads and 170 contacts but only 109 opportunities created and 0 won — 25 contacts never entered the pipeline, suggesting an intake leak, not an ads problem.
GBP actions dropped -100% in the last 7 days (from measurable engagement to 0), and IG reach has been 0 for all 28 days in the series — both organic channels are dark.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair Google Ads conversion tracking — $532.43 spent with 0 conversions confirms a pixel/tag failure, not a performance issue.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $532.43 over 28 days with zero tracked conversions — this is a confirmed tracking failure, not a bidding or creative problem. Immediate action: audit the Google Ads conversion tag on the landing page and in GTM, confirm it fires on the call/lead event, and compare against the 115 clicks that did land. Success is defined as at least one verified conversion event firing in Google Ads within 3 days of the fix. Re-check by 2026-09-12.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL intake leak: 25 of 170 contacts never created an opportunity — identify and close the pipeline entry gap.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 170 contacts but only 109 opportunities created, meaning at least 25 contacts (15%) never entered the Device Fulfilment pipeline. This is a CRM intake gap, not an ads delivery problem. Action: pull the 25 contact records, identify their source and why no opportunity was triggered, and patch the automation or intake rule causing the drop. Success: opportunities created ≥ contacts received for any new leads by 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Watch Sep 8 Google spend spike ($81.12 vs $10–20 norm) — confirm whether a budget change was made before scaling further.
suggestions.monday_update: Google spend jumped to $81.12 on Sep 8, roughly 4–6x the prior daily average of $10–20. With conversion tracking broken (F1), this elevated spend has no measurable return. Do not increase Google budget further until the conversion tag is verified firing (S1). Re-check spend level and any conversion data on 2026-09-12 — if tracking is fixed and conversions appear, re-evaluate scaling at that point.
